reason: It's brand new with zero reviews, and I only need full-site screenshots a few times a year. I'd try the free tier on a small client site, but I'm not paying a monthly fee for something I use a handful of times.
objection: No reviews, no proof it handles real client sites with lazy-loaded images, sticky headers and cookie banners, and I don't need a subscription for a few handovers a year.
would_change_my_mind: Solid reviews from other freelancers showing clean full-page captures on real sites, plus a pay-per-capture option instead of a monthly plan.
